Agentic AI Engineer

Experience: 4-8 Years
Location: Indore/Bengaluru/Hyderabad /Pune.
Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract / Contract-to-Hire

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, tool usage, and workflow automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), and modern AI frameworks to build scalable, production-ready AI applications.

The candidate should have hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, or FAISS, and prompt engineering. Strong knowledge of multi-agent systems, AI orchestration, memory management, tool calling, and agent evaluation is essential.

Experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is required. Familiarity with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Redis, along with messaging technologies like Kafka or RabbitMQ, will be an added advantage.

The ideal candidate should have excellent problem-solving skills, experience integrating AI agents with enterprise applications, optimizing performance and security, monitoring AI systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to deliver reliable, scalable, and innovative AI-powered solutions.

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

5+ Years

Noida/Gurugram/Kochi/Bangalore/Pune/Mumbai





Role Purpose The Forward Deployed Engineer builds and delivers production-grade, AI-powered systems directly with customers. This is a builder role: you will write, ship, and operate code in real customer environments. The FDE bridges product intent, engineering execution, and real-world deployment - owning solutions end-to-end. From discovery through production, the FDE ensures Agentic AI systems deliver measurable customer and business impact.




What Youll Do




Design and Deploy Production AI Systems

Design, build, and deploy production-ready AI systems in real customer environments.
Implement Agentic AI solutions (RAG, orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-step workflows).
Translate ambiguous customer problems into shippable technical architectures with clear trade-offs.
Move solutions from proof-of-concept to production with measurable adoption.
Engineer for enterprise-grade quality: secure, scalable, observable, resilient.



Own End-to-End Customer Delivery

Lead delivery from discovery and architecture through rollout, iteration, and operational readiness.
Embed directly with customer teams to understand tech stack, workflow constraints, and success criteria.
Make pragmatic architectural decisions under delivery pressure and evolving constraints in the customer stack.
Measure success by delivered impact and adoption - not effort or billable time.



Operationalize for Scale

Establish deployment patterns, evaluation loops, and monitoring frameworks.
Implement reliability patterns: retries, fallbacks, idempotency, and safe failure modes for agentic workflows.
Tune systems for performance and economics (latency, throughput, cost) without sacrificing quality.
Mentor engineers in production-grade AI delivery practices and reusable reference architectures.



Partner Across Product and Platform

Collaborate with AI Engineers, platform teams, and research to align architecture with long-term direction.
Provide real-world deployment feedback to strengthen platform capabilities and accelerators.
Balance experimentation velocity with enterprise-grade reliability.



Infuence at Executive and Customer Altitude

Communicate architecture, risks, and constraints clearly to executives and non-technical stakeholders.
Frame decisions across scope, reliability, speed, and cost in decision-ready language.
Build trust through transparency, delivery rigor, and measurable outcomes.



Transition Delivery to Durable Ownership

Ensure systems transition cleanly into sustained operation with clear ownership and documentation.
Define monitoring, support, and iteration plans; reduce ambiguity for inheriting teams.
Support long-term adoption and continuous improvement cycles.



Requirements

5+ years in software engineering, architecture, or technical delivery; strong record of shipping production systems.
Demonstrated customer-embedded delivery: discovery-to-deployment in enterprise environments.
Hands-on backend and integration engineering (APIs, services, data integrations); strong debugging skills.
Experience building LLM applications (tool calling, RAG, orchestration) and creating eval/quality gates.
Production deployment discipline (CI/CD, environments, containers) and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Security and privacy fundamentals (secrets, access controls, PII handling) applied in implementations.
Strong communication and stakeholder influence; comfortable translating trade-offs to decision-makers.

Senior Staff Engineer AI & Agentic Engineering




Location: India (Flexible — WFO preferred, otherwise 2 quarterly visits are compulsory)




The Role

As Senior Staff Engineer, you'll be one of the senior-most individual contributors driving that shift from the engineering side — turning "we should use AI here" into working, production systems. This is not a role where the product hands you a spec. You'll often be the one deciding what's worth building before anyone else has framed the problem.




Your core mandate is threefold:

Build agentic capability into the core platform. Design and ship AI/agent-driven features — autonomous workflows, decision engines, LLM-integrated tooling — into a commerce platform already processing billions in transaction volume.
Operate at the edge of ambiguity. Take a rough direction, not a groomed backlog, and turn it into a scoped, shippable plan yourself. You'll be trusted to define the "what" as much as the "how."
Set the technical bar for how we build with AI. You won't be the only engineer touching this space — you'll help shape the standard others follow.



What You'll Walk Into

An agentic initiative already underway — early proof-of-concept work has shipped, momentum exists, but there's no dedicated senior technical owner driving it end-to-end yet
A production platform with deep integrations across QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and more — technically complex and high-stakes
Owning distinct areas of the platform — you'll have real IC peers at your level, not just reports
A manager who will be a technical thought partner, not a filter — you'll engage directly with architecture and roadmap decisions, not through a PM layer



What You'll Do

Agentic Product Development

Design and build AI/agent-driven features across the commerce platform — from proof-of-concept to production
Own ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems end-to-end without waiting on a fully-groomed spec

Technical Ownership & Craft

Make and defend architecture calls independently; bring options with tradeoffs, not open-ended questions
Partner with our architecture function on how agentic systems integrate cleanly into the existing platform layer, rather than bypassing it

Roadmap & Direction

Partner with engineering and product leadership on what to build, not just receive requirements — shape the roadmap, don't just consume it
Identify where AI creates real leverage for customers (vs. where it's just a buzzword) and make the case for it

Cross-Functional Leadership

Set technical direction for others working in the agentic space; raise the bar on how the team builds with AI
Communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders



What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

8+ years in backend/systems engineering, with real production experience owning complex systems end-to-end
Hands-on fluency with AI/LLM tooling — you've built with agents, RAG, tool-calling, or similar, not just used ChatGPT
Demonstrated comfort operating without a fully-defined spec — a track record of shaping a fuzzy problem into a concrete, shippable plan
Strong, independent architectural judgment — comfortable defending a design decision under scrutiny
Self-directed — you don't need a product manager to break down the work before you can start
Clear communicator — can explain a technical decision and its tradeoffs to both engineers and leadership



Strong advantages:

Experience with .NET / C# (our core stack)
Prior experience in a startup or small-team environment where you owned ambiguity by necessity, not choice
Exposure to e-commerce, ERP, or integration-heavy platforms



Why Join Webgility

Real impact: Your work directly shapes how thousands of small businesses operate, not just how data moves between systems
Builder's role: You're defining Webgility's agentic capability, not maintaining an established roadmap someone else set
Domain depth: Ecommerce + accounting is a complex, high-stakes integration problem with a large TAM
Direct access: You'll work closely with engineering leadership on architecture and direction, with real influence over what gets built next



Webgility is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
